pages.excerpt:
The**Ministry of Culture**([Italian](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_language):*Ministero della Cultura - MiC*) is the[ministry](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ministry_(government_department))of the[Government of Italy](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Government_of_Italy)in charge of[national museums](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_museums_in_Italy)and maintenance of historical monuments. MiC's headquarters are located in the historic[Collegio Romano Palace](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Roman_Colleges)(via del Collegio Romano 27, in central Rome) and the current[Minister of Culture](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Italian_Minister_of_Culture)is[Alessandro Giuli](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alessandro_Giuli).
